name: caveman
description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick — Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like caveman
one_liner: A setting for AI coding assistants that makes them talk and think in short, blunt phrases instead of long explanations, cutting how many words (and how much money) each request uses.
buyer: A startup CTO watching their AI coding tool bill climb who wants an easy way to cut token usage without giving up code quality.
business_use_cases: An engineering team installs it to lower monthly AI-assistant API costs across dozens of developers.
A cost-conscious solo developer uses it to stretch a limited AI API budget further on side projects.
A consultancy that bills AI usage to clients uses it to shrink client invoices and stay competitive on price.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'cut your AI coding bill' audit that installs this and similar token-saving skills for a company's dev team.

steal_this: This weekend, build a short case-study post showing a real before/after token-cost comparison using this tool, and use it as a lead magnet for AI-cost-optimization consulting.
